title: 第三課：週末做什麼？
zh1:
安同：田中，你喜歡聽音樂嗎？
田中：我不喜歡聽音樂。我喜歡運動。
安同：你喜歡打網球嗎？
田中：我不喜歡打網球。
安同：你喜歡做什麼？
田中：打棒球和游泳，你呢？
安同：我常打籃球，也常踢足球。
田中：我覺得踢足球很好玩。
安同：明天是週末，我們早上去踢足球，怎麼樣？
田中：好啊！
py1:
Āntóng：Tiánzhōng, nǐ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè ma?
Tiánzhōng：Wǒ bù xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè. Wǒ xǐhuān yùndòng.
Āntóng：Nǐ xǐhuān dǎ wǎngqiú ma?
Tiánzhōng：Wǒ bù xǐhuān dǎ wǎngqiú.
Āntóng：Nǐ xǐhuān zuò shénme?
Tiánzhōng：Dǎ bàngqiú hàn yóuyǒng, nǐ ne?
Āntóng：Wǒ cháng dǎ lánqiú, yě cháng tī zúqiú.
Tiánzhōng：Wǒ juéde tī zúqiú hěn hǎowán.
Āntóng：Míngtiān shì zhōumò, wǒmen zǎoshàng qù tī zúqiú, zěnmeyàng?
Tiánzhōng：Hǎo a!
en1:
Antong：Tianzhong, do you like listening to music?
Tianzhong：I do not like listening to music. I like to exercise.
Antong：Do you like to play tennis?
Tianzhong：I do not like to play tennis.
Antong：What do you like to do?
Tianzhong：Play baseball and swim. And you?
Antong：I often play basketball and also often play soccer.
Tianzhong：I think soccer is fun.
Antong：The weekend is tomorrow. How about we go play soccer tomorrow morning?
Tianzhong：Great!
zh2:
如玉：今天晚上我們去看電影，好不好？
月美：好啊！
如玉：妳想看美國電影還是臺灣電影？
月美：美國電影、臺灣電影，我都想看。
如玉：我們看臺灣電影吧！
月美：好啊！看電影可以學中文。
如玉：晚上要不要一起吃晚飯？
月美：好，我們去吃越南菜。
py2:
Rúyù：Jīntiān wǎnshàng wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng, hǎo bù hǎo?
Yuèměi：Hǎo a!
Rúyù：Nǐ xiǎng kàn Měiguó diànyǐng háishì Táiwān diànyǐng?
Yuèměi：Měiguó diànyǐng, Táiwān diànyǐng, wǒ dōu xiǎng kàn.
Rúyù：Wǒmen kàn Táiwān diànyǐng ba!
Yuèměi：Hǎo a! Kàn diànyǐng kěyǐ xué Zhōngwén.
Rúyù：Wǎnshàng yào bú yào yìqǐ chī wǎnfàn?
Yuèměi：Hǎo, wǒmen qù chī Yuènán cài.
en2:
Ruyu：Let’s go see a movie tonight, OK?
Yuemei：Sure.
Ruyu：Do you want to see an American movie or a Taiwanese movie?
Yuemei：Either an American movie or a Taiwanese film is fine with me.
Ruyu：Let’s go ahead and see a Taiwanese movie.
Yuemei：That’s fine. Watching movies, I can learn Chinese.
Ruyu：Would you like to have dinner together tonight?
Yuemei：Okay. Let’s go have Vietnamese food.

act:
I. What Does This Person Like to Do?
【目標 Goal】Learning to describe sports or leisure activities that another person likes.
【做法 Task】Observe the pictures and describe what the person often does in the morning and evening, and what the person did today.
【例】他常看電影還是常打籃球？
他今天打網球還是打籃球？
他常踢足球還是常游泳？

II. Making Suggestions
【目標 Goal】Learning to politely ask for opinions and make suitable suggestions.
【做法 Task】In groups of three, role-play a discussion about plans for the weekend.
【例】A：明天是週末，我們做什麼？
B：我們去打網球吧！
C：我不喜歡打網球，我們去看電影吧！
A：我不喜歡看電影，我們去游泳吧，好不好？
B：好，我們一起去游泳吧！

III. Find What You Have in Common
【目標 Goal】Learning to talk about common preferences shared by two people or groups.
【做法 Task】Talk with classmates and report the interests you have in common.
【例】我常喝咖啡，小王也常喝咖啡。
我們和他的弟弟都很常游泳。

IV. Survey
【目標 Goal】Learning to ask and answer choice questions.
【做法 Task】Survey classmates about their preferences and record the answers.
【例】A：你喜歡打籃球還是踢足球？
B1：我喜歡打籃球，也喜歡踢足球。
B2：我喜歡打籃球，不喜歡踢足球。
B3：打籃球、踢足球，我都不喜歡。
cult:
臺灣獨特的休閒活動——釣蝦 Shrimp Fishing
釣蝦是臺灣非常獨特且具代表性的庶民休閒活動，不僅深受在地臺灣人喜愛，也吸引許多居住在臺灣的外國人與外國遊客。

釣蝦場內的蝦隻專門為釣蝦活動培育，場地對公眾開放並按小時計費。釣蝦起源於1980年代的臺灣南部，之後風靡全臺。早期多為戶外場地，後來為避免日曬雨淋，逐漸轉為室內休閒場所。

釣客可以把親手釣到的鮮蝦放在場內烤爐烤熟，或付費請工作人員代烤並直接享用。最經典的吃法是「鹽烤鮮蝦配啤酒」。這項步調悠閒的活動，是釋放工作壓力、遠離都市喧囂的好方法。

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: Time words usually appear after the subject, or before the subject.
blocks.ex:
我們今天去看電影。
We went to see a movie today.
週末他要去打籃球。
This weekend, he is going to play basketball.

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: Subject + Time Word + VP; or Time Word + Subject + VP.
blocks.ex:
你明天想去游泳嗎？
Would you like to go swimming tomorrow?
明天你想做什麼？
What would you like to do tomorrow?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: When several time words occur together, arrange them from larger to smaller units.
blocks.ex:
明天晚上
tomorrow evening
週末早上
weekend morning

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: To Go Do Something

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 去 qù followed by a verb phrase expresses the intention or purpose of going to do something.
blocks.ex:
我去打網球。
I am going to play tennis.
我們和老師都去看電影。
We and the teacher are all going to see a movie.
他去踢足球。
He went to play soccer.

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: Subject + 去 + Verb Phrase. Negation, auxiliary verbs, and adverbs must appear before 去.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: Place 不 before 去.
blocks.ex:
我不去打籃球。
I am not going to play basketball.
明天早上我不去游泳。
I am not going swimming tomorrow morning.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: Auxiliary verbs and adverbs precede 去.
blocks.ex:
你要去看電影嗎？
Would you like to go see a movie?
你們常去吃越南菜嗎？
Do you often go eat Vietnamese food?

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Topic-Comment Sentences

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: To describe, explain, or comment on a specific person or thing, move it to the beginning as the topic; the rest is the comment.
blocks.ex:
烏龍茶，臺灣人都喜歡喝。
Oolong tea, Taiwanese people all like it.
哥哥、姐姐，我都沒有。
Older brothers and sisters, I have none.

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: The topic always appears at the beginning of the sentence.
blocks.ex:
打棒球，我不喜歡。
Playing baseball, I do not like it.
這張照片，我覺得很好看。
This photo, I think it is quite nice.

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: If the fronted object is a collective noun or contains multiple nouns, add 都 dōu in the comment.
blocks.ex:
中國菜，我都喜歡吃。
Chinese food, I like all of it.
弟弟、妹妹，我都有。
Younger brothers and sisters, I have both.

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Adverbs 也、都、常

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: Adverbs 也、都、常 appear before the verb phrase: Subject + 也／都／常 + VP.
blocks.ex:
我是美國人，他也是美國人。
I am American, and he is also American.
我們都喜歡他。
We all like him.
我常打網球。
I often play tennis.

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: When 也 occurs with 都 or 常, 也 must precede 都 or 常: Subject + 也 + 都／常 + VP.
blocks.ex:
他們也都是日本人。
They are also all Japanese.
你常喝咖啡，我也常喝咖啡。
You often drink coffee, and I do too.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: In negative sentences, 也 precedes 不／沒; 常 follows the negator. 都 before the negator gives total negation, while 不都 gives partial negation.
blocks.ex:
我沒有弟弟，也沒有妹妹。
I have neither a younger brother nor a younger sister.
我們都不是美國人。
None of us is American.
他們不都是美國人。
Not all of them are American.
我不常看電影。
I seldom watch movies.

gps.title: V. Making Suggestions with 吧 ba

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Making Suggestions

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: The sentence-final particle 吧 ba makes a suggestion or politely asks for agreement.
blocks.ex:
我們去喝咖啡吧。
Let’s go drink coffee.
我們去看臺灣電影吧！
Let’s watch a Taiwanese movie.

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: 吧 ba always appears at the end of the sentence.

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: Adding 吧 to an imperative softens the tone. 喝吧 sounds friendly, while 喝 alone can sound like a blunt command.
blocks.ex:
喝吧。
Have a drink.
喝！
Drink!
